classification.difficultyReason: Uses replacement, multiplication along independent paths and a complement for at least one.

content.prompt:
A bag contains 12 green counters and 8 red counters.
Faith removes a counter, writes down its colour then puts it back in the bag.
She then selects another counter and writes down its colour.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the probability that Faith selects two green counters.

answer.worked:
Replacement keeps the probabilities the same for both selections.
$$\begin{aligned}P(GG)&=\frac{12}{20}\times\frac{12}{20}\\P(GG)&=\frac{144}{400}\\P(GG)&=\frac{9}{25}\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the probability that Faith selects at least one green counter.

answer.worked:
The complementary event is selecting two red counters.
$$\begin{aligned}P(RR)&=\frac{8}{20}\times\frac{8}{20}\\P(RR)&=\frac{64}{400}\\P(\text{at least one green})&=1-P(RR)\\P(\text{at least one green})&=1-\frac{64}{400}\\P(\text{at least one green})&=\frac{336}{400}=\frac{21}{25}\end{aligned}$$
